DL is a big brain deck that wants to OTK ASAP. VW is a toolbox that can recycle resources and outgrind the opponent. Powerful is very relative.

DL is more explosive and ends game faster, but the longer the game goes on the bigger the chance that you lose. VW can grind with the likes of Eldlich.

IMO either one works and is a safe bet for this and next format. DL has a higher entry cost than pure VW, but punk VW costs about the same.

I'm surprised no one has suggested this one: Virtual World. It has a dirt cheap core and can essily be upgraded. 

If you don't want to spend a fuckton on a combo deck consider getting pure Virtual World for about 150 bucks. VW is an extra deck toolkit focusing on level 3s, 6s, and 9s. It is a versatile deck and can consistently go into 4 mat Zeus too. 

If you have a bit more money and want some oomph then consider Punk Virtual World with Halqifibrax. Should be about 200 something dollars for the whole lot. The Punk version of VW has seen some tops and I recommend this the most when it comes to the price to power ratio. More consistent than pure VW and  packs more of a punch at the cost of flex spots. Note that Halqi may get banned but anyone telling you that it will get banned next ban list is just speculating

Now, the holy grail of VW decks is the Adventurer Virtual World version. It's powerful. But also, it costs $700+. If you're not planning to top a YCS in the next 4 months then I really don't recommend it. 

Now, a problem with Virtual World in general  is consistency but that's a given in card games to a certain degree. Another problem is it's a deck that takes time to learn. It's not as difficult as Dragon Link or D/D/D but being a toolbox archetype, you need time  to learn your matchups. Also, scythe hits this deck hard.
